properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 6 at 4:04PM ChST until November 7 at 4:00PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 7 to 9 feet in the surf zone.
Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...For the High Surf Advisory, north facing reefs of the
Marianas. For the High Rip Current Risk, north and east facing
reefs.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM ChST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion. Rip currents can sweep even the best
swimmers away from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A pulse of elevated northeast trade swell,
enhanced by a passing tropical disturbance to the north, as well
as a lighter long-period north swell, will generate hazardous
surf along north facing reefs, and a high risk of rip currents
along north and east facing reefs of the Marianas. The
disturbance and elevated swell look to pass quickly through the
area, with surf falling below hazardous conditions Saturday.
properties.instruction:
Rip currents will be life threatening. Inexperienced swimmers
should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions.
If caught in a rip current, relax and float. Don't swim against
the current. If able, swim in a direction following the shoreline.
If unable to escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.
